name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: A strange fossil carries a Darkshore mystery across the Great Sea to the Wetlands. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sends you to Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor, hoping he can unlock its secrets.

sections.title: A Curious Discovery
sections.body: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sees a likeness between the strange fossil from Darkshore and a relic shown at an Explorers' League conference in Ironforge. Archaeologist Flagongut presented that relic and believed such fossils held powers waiting to be unlocked. Greywhisker believes Flagongut is the only dwarf who can discern what makes this Kalimdor find so extraordinary.

sections.title: A Voyage Across the Sea
sections.body: You carry the mysterious fossil from Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms. Flagongut was last seen lodging at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, waiting for an armed escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. When you bring him the fossil, a Darkshore survey reaches across continents as part of a wider archaeological inquiry.

faq.q: Why does Greywhisker send me all the way to Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker remembers Archaeologist Flagongut displaying an identical relic at an annual Explorers' League conference in Ironforge. Greywhisker believes Flagongut has the knowledge to unlock its hidden power, and sends you to his last known location at Menethil Harbor.

Archaeologist Flagongut is an Explorers' League researcher stationed in the Wetlands. He is staying at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor while preparing for an expedition to the perilous Whelgar Excavation Site.
The mysterious fossil is an ancient specimen retrieved from Darkshore. Flagongut once claimed that an identical specimen he studied held latent magical or historical power waiting to be unlocked.

faq.q: What does Flagongut say when you deliver the fossil?
faq.answer: Flagongut is astonished that a relic identical to his own research sample came from distant Kalimdor. The discovery confirms that ancient history links the two landmasses.

faq.q: Where does Flagongut want to go next?
faq.answer: Flagongut is waiting in Menethil Harbor for an escort inland to the Whelgar Excavation Site, a major dig in the Wetlands.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the Absent Minded Prospector storyline?
faq.answer: This is the transit leg of the Absent Minded Prospector storyline. After you escort and rescue Prospector Remtravel in Darkshore and examine his excavated relic with Greywhisker, the inquiry moves from northern Kalimdor to Explorers' League experts in the Eastern Kingdoms.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see how far the Explorers' League reaches, linking fieldwork in remote Kalimdor with fellow scholars based in Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance adventurer, you travel by Alliance shipping routes across the sea from Kalimdor to Menethil Harbor, keeping League branches connected.
